requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL 将普通任务的委派视为 AI 的运行期执行策略，同时仅在独立性属于校验协议语义时强制 fresh context。

case.given: impl-track reaches an ordinary ready leaf task without an isolation hook
case.then: the current AI SHALL choose local or delegated execution from task boundaries, context continuity, file overlap, parallel value, and available runtime capabilities
case.and: the task MUST NOT require a fresh subagent merely because it is a leaf task

case.given: a DAG wave contains multiple ready tasks
case.then: the DAG SHALL define readiness and dependency order only
case.and: the AI MAY execute ready tasks locally, delegate them, or combine both strategies while respecting concurrency and file ownership

case.then: the track executor SHALL objectively verify acceptance, tests, and diff scope before completion
case.and: only the track executor SHALL write track.xml status, acceptance checkmarks, findings, and task commits

case.given: a GapLoop, AttractorCheck, explicit independent verify, or user-requested independent audit is invoked
case.when: the protocol performs its independent check
case.then: the protocol SHALL use a fresh independent context as specified
case.and: ordinary implementation freedom MUST NOT weaken those isolation guarantees

case.given: an existing workspace contains the historical built-in coding AttractorCheck on discuss:before, impl-quick:before, or revise-track:before
case.then: the exact obsolete built-in hooks SHALL be removed
case.and: unrelated user hooks and configuration SHALL be preserved
